HEATHEN-ONLY EVENTS (HE-01 to HE-45, draft for the owner, 2026-11-23, target v1.35.98)
New Believers only. Island events about the Heathens' own lives: honoring their dead, Heathen versions of events our villagers already have, and small moments of camp life.

collection.description: It is a still, warm night at the encampment, and two Heathens watch the fireflies.

description_variants.description: It is a still, warm night at the encampment, and two Isolans watch the fireflies.

setup.name: The scene
setup.text: It's a still, warm night at the encampment. Somebody is playing a reed flute. Somebody else is telling a story to the children, who are pretending not to be sleepy. (subject) and (friend) sit on the step of the mud hut with their masks pushed up, watching the fireflies drift over the scrub, and agree that, all things considered, it has been a good day.
